title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 2: Opinion Essay on Time-Limited Writing and Staged Assessment
prompt: Some people believe that students should be required to complete all major writing assessments under strict time limits, because this mirrors the pressure of real academic and professional life. Others argue that staged assessment, in which work is drafted, reviewed and revised over several weeks, produces better writing and fairer judgements of ability. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. In your answer, you should explain which approach you think is more valuable for developing strong writers, and you should support your position with reasons and examples. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟雅思学术类 Task 2 练习，所有情境与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请先仔细阅读 prompt 中的完整题目，确认题目要求你讨论双方观点并给出自己的立场。建议用约 5 分钟审题与构思：分别列出限时写作与分阶段评估的主要理由，再明确你的个人立场。写作时请确保每个主体段围绕一个中心论点展开，并用具体理由或例子支撑；避免只罗列观点而缺少论证。请控制在 40 分钟内完成，写完后检查字数是否达到 250 词，并核对是否回应了题目的全部要求。
